title: Munch Maze
description: Guide Munch the bouncy blob through glowing candy mazes and eat every dot before the four silly Gloops catch you. Grab a Super Snack and the Gloops turn blue, so you can munch them for big points. Play Classic or Easy, swipe or use the arrow keys, and try three different mazes.
notes: Original maze-chase game: hero Munch and the Gloops Zippy, Sneaky, Tricky and Dozy are original characters; the three 28x31 mazes (Candy Lane, Mint Caves, Starry Swirl) are original, mirrored, have no dead ends and wrapping side tunnels. Classic mechanics: tile movement with cornering and buffered turns on a fixed 120 Hz step, the four chase personalities, the scatter/chase timer with reversals, house dot counters plus the no-dot timer, frightened chain 200/400/800/1600, eyes return home, two bonus snacks per level, extra life at 10,000, arcade-style level speed tables and three short original cartoons. Easy mode: slower Gloops, 5 lives, longer Super Snack time. Controls: swipe anywhere (slide to keep steering), optional on-screen arrow buttons, arrows/WASD, P/Esc pause, M mute. Saves best score and best level per mode, total dots and settings in BRB.storage key 'munch-maze-v1'. Leaderboard: Classic only (BRB.score.submit(score, 'points') then BRB.gameOver); Easy calls BRB.gameOver({won:false}) with no score. Sounds use BRB.sfx plus a small original WebAudio synth (chomp, hum) that follows BRB.sfx.muted. No flashing faster than 2 per second. window.__brbTest drives the game for tests. Loads Google Font Fredoka.
